tg-oroszkatonai.undocumented: No third-party documentation of this channel was found, despite it being the Hungarian mirror's fourth-largest credited source. Searched DFRLab, Átlátszó's Hungarian-Telegram investigation, Lakmusz, EUvsDisinfo, ISD, VIGINUM and the Pravda-network literature; the only pages naming the handle are the channel itself and the mirror that credits it. The largest published study of Hungarian-language Telegram in the campaign period — Vox Harbor's analysis of 628,000+ messages from 30,000+ groups, reported by Reuters on 10 April 2026 — does not name it either.
